factValues.name: gr:fact-1b0806262d5fe1ca_fv
factValues.value: For the financial period ended 30 November 2023 the company was entitled to exemption from audit under section 477 of the Companies Act 2006 relating to small companies.

factValues.name: gr:fact-a2d28aeed601f3e2_fv
factValues.value: The director acknowledges his responsibilities for complying with the requirements of the Companies Act 2006 with respect to accounting records and the preparation of financial statements.

factValues.name: gr:fact-05d59ef7effbb57b_fv
factValues.value: The member has not required the company to obtain an audit of its financial statements for the period in question in accordance with section 476.

factValues.name: gr:fact-9541c98917bdc935_fv
factValues.value: These financial statements have been prepared and delivered in accordance with the provisions applicable to companies subject to the small companies regime.

factValues.name: gr:fact-339f3d6a0af2db7e_fv
factValues.value: These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with FRS 102 “The Financial Reporting Standard applicable in the UK and Republic of Ireland” (“FRS 102”) and the requirements of the Companies Act 2006 as applicable to companies subject to the small companies regime.

factValues.name: gr:fact-ade8ceb6699f3eda_fv
factValues.value: The financial statements have been prepared under the historical cost convention. The principal accounting policies adopted are set out below.

factValues.name: gr:fact-011ccfa059925804_fv
factValues.value: Investment property, which is property held to earn rentals and/or for capital appreciation, is recognised at cost as explained in note 3 of the financial statements, which includes the purchase cost and any directly attributable expenditure.

factValues.name: gr:fact-d87ee059bee97e1d_fv
factValues.value: Cash and cash equivalentsare basic financial assets and include cash in hand, deposits held at call with banks, other short-term liquid investments with original maturities of three months or less, and bank overdrafts. Bank overdrafts are shown within borrowings in current liabilities.

factValues.name: gr:fact-f117bab1b717eb0d_fv
factValues.value: The company has elected to apply the provisions of Section 11 ‘Basic Financial Instruments’ and Section 12 ‘Other Financial Instruments Issues’ of FRS 102 to all of its financial instruments. Financial instruments are recognised in the company's balance sheet when the company becomes party to the contractual provisions of the instrument.Financial assets and liabilities are offset, with the net amounts presented in the financial statements, when there is a legally enforceable right to set off the recognised amounts and there is an intention to settle on a net basis or to realise the asset and settle the liability simultaneously.
